```lean
theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x + y = 2) : x * y ≤ 1 := by
  have h1 : x + y = 2 := h
  have h2 : (x - 1) * (y - 1) ≥ 0 :=
    by rw [h1]; simp only [mul_sub, sub_add, add_sub, mul_left_distrib, mul_right_distrib, add_mul, one_add]
    exact (add_nonneg (le_refl 1) (le_refl 1)).trans (mul_nonneg (le_zero (by rwa le_add_right at h1)) (le_zero (by rwa le_add_right at h1)))
  rw [mul_sub, sub_add, add_sub, mul_left_distrib, mul_right_distrib, add_mul, one_add] at h2
  rw [h1] at h2
  exact h2.trans (le_add_right 1 1)
```
